standard.summary: original=固定深度预取（默认，与历史字节路径一致）；adaptive=感知 blockskip / 在线调深度。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.original: 预取深度固定，行为好预期。
optionDescriptions.adaptive: 看着 blockskip 之类调深度，空泡少时快，调不准则抖。

standard_en.summary: original prefetches at a fixed depth -- the default, matching the historical byte-for-byte path; adaptive is aware of blockskip and tunes the depth online.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default, then short-test a few steps before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is on at the same time.

optionDescriptions.original: The prefetch depth is fixed, so behaviour is easy to predict.
optionDescriptions.adaptive: Tunes the depth by watching things like blockskip: faster when there are few bubbles, jittery when the tuning is off.

advanced.principle: original=固定深度预取（默认，与历史字节路径一致）；adaptive=感知 blockskip / 在线调深度。

advanced_en.principle: original = fixed-depth prefetch (default, byte-identical to the historical path); adaptive = blockskip-aware / online depth tuning.
